name: E5 blaster carbine
description: The E5 blaster carbine, or E-5 blaster carbine, was a blaster carbine used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems throughout the Clone Wars and later by criminal, paramilitary, or Rebel groups during the Galactic Civil War. It was a shortened version of the B1 battle droid's famous E-5 blaster rifle manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop.
